newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia tin up six cents to 14.56 rgt/kg.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia tin up six cents to 14.56 rgt/kg.

text.p: Malaysia's tin price rose six cents to close at 14.56 ringgit ($5.84) a kg after tracking a strong overnight close on the London Metal Exchange (LME), traders said.
"There was some good buying after the overnight in London but this was offset later by large offers," said a trader.
There were initial bids for 139 tonnes against offers for 126. Final turnover was 125 tonnes compared to 103 on Monday.
Buyers were Europeans, Japanese and locals. There was a discount of $25 against the London market, compared to a premium of $15 previously.-K.Baranee Krishnan (603-2307509) ($1=2.4920)
